name: Home page loads in Amharic with search box and headline
Empty query keeps the Search button disabled
Amharic query returns ranked results with count and latency
Results are sorted by descending match score
Bounding-box highlight overlay is drawn at the normalized coordinates (x=10%, y=18%, w=80%, h=13%)
Selecting another result jumps the viewer to that result's page
Previous-result button is disabled on the first result
Next-result button is disabled on the last result
Zoom in enlarges and zoom out shrinks the page image
Page navigation stops at the last page (button disabled)
A synonym query (ታክስ) still finds tax passages (semantic match demo)
A query with no match shows the empty-state message
Language toggle switches the interface to English
Unauthenticated visit to /admin redirects to the login page
Wrong password shows an inline error and stays on login
Correct credentials open the admin page and show the document list
Uploaded PDF appears in the table with status Processing
Status polling updates the document to Indexed without a page reload
Unsupported file type is rejected with a message
Deleting a document (after confirmation) removes it from the list
After sign-out, admin pages are protected again
On a phone, opening a result shows the viewer full-screen
On a phone, the Back button returns to the result list
No horizontal page scrolling at 390 px width
No JavaScript or console errors during the whole session
